violations: Returned food on a paid order (owner rule: returned food is booked as waste). The plan answers 409 PAID_USE_REFUND for any 'ready' order with a paid cash, card or Raast tender and sends it to the refund engine. refundOrder refuses orders that are not completed: assertRefundableStatus (pos/service.ts:2795-2806) returns 422 NOT_REFUNDABLE, 'cancel it instead'. A prepaid online or till-paid delivery that comes back then has only the plain /orders/:id/cancel, which puts the stock back and books no waste. FIX: allow paid tenders. Cancel with waste through the hook. Any money goes back through the existing cancelled-ticket hand-back (refundOrder -> refundDueOnCancelledTicket, LEDGER-R5). Return refundDueCents in the response so the manager can act on it.

Owner's role list (RGM / chef / F&B manager). The plan maps RGM to 'management', but that role is the CEO/exec tier (auth/middleware.ts:245). It already holds every module (MANAGEMENT_MODULES = ALL_MODULES, moduleAccess.ts:97), so the owner's RGM grant changes nothing. It also leaves out the restaurant-level manager: foh_management, which is where legacy 'manager' accounts were moved (decision 7). FIX: default-grant emergency_overrides to boh_management, fnb_manager and foh_management (management and admin get it automatically), and confirm with the owner (Q1).

Company separation, audit trail. Food-returned goes through cancelOrder, and cancelOrder audits under input.actor.tenantId (orders/service.ts:1634): the operator's company, not the order's. FIX: pass actor.tenantId = order.concept.tenantId from the emergency route, or change cancelOrder to audit with the order's company (orderBooksOf).

Company separation, bans must stay inside the company that issued them. The plan keeps Customer.bannedAt as an 'any company' mirror and defers two readers that act on it everywhere: lib/marketingAudience.ts:24-30 (bannedAt: null) and workers/loyaltyTriggers.ts:516 (the referral check on referrer.bannedAt). CLAUDE.md says this cannot be done later. FIX in the same change: drop bannedAt from marketingAudience (bannedCustomerIdsAtCompany is already per company), and check the referrer with activeBanAtCompany for the referral's company.

Fail-open scope and ungated customer data. GET /complaints/stats still uses req.staffUser.tenantFilter (complaints/routes.ts:81); the plan fixes only GET / and PATCH. /complaints is also not in GATED_PREFIXES, so every staff role (kitchen, IT, cashier) would read ban appeals with phone, email and strike history. FIX: use scopeTenantWhere on /stats. Add a GATED_PREFIXES rule for '/complaints' listing the modules whose pages call it ('complaints', 'crm', plus any dashboard caller). Return the ban and strike details on appeal rows to MANAGERS only.

Fleet riders under RLS. The 'returned' job event is written inside transitionOrder's cancel transaction, which runs on the RLS-scoped prisma client (orders/service.ts:1344). jobEventTx needs the rider's company, and a fleet partner's rider row is hidden from that client (dispatch/service.ts:19-27), so eventData() silently writes nothing (dispatch/service.ts:104-108). FIX: read rider.tenantId with serviceClient before the transaction and pass it in, or write the event after commit with recordJobEvent. Build the GET /emergency-overrides list on serviceClient with explicit company filters, as /dispatch/board does.

takeRiderOff throwing 409 CODE_WITH_RIDER breaks the system callers. withdrawOffer runs in loops in the offer-timeout worker (workers/riderDispatch.ts:136), on a fleet agreement ending (riders/routes.ts:174) and on a rider going off shift (rider/service.ts:184). A throw stops each loop part-way. FIX: for a rerouted, undelivered order, takeRiderOff with onlyIfNotAccepted or onlyIfRiderId returns changed:false (a no-op). Only an explicit dispatcher assign or unassign gets the 409.

Build split against the CLAUDE.md parallel-agent rule. Some files are both owned by an agent and listed as orchestrator-integrated: pos/routes.ts (agent D), inventory/voidWaste.ts (agent B) and reconciliation/backfillOrders.ts (agent D). Other files are shared with other Wave B areas but missing from the risk list: trustops/routes.ts (the cash-requests area replaces vouchers and petty cash there), lib/chartOfAccounts.ts, frontend/admin/src/lib/appRoles.ts (new module ids from food cost and FA), reports/service.ts salesByTender (on-account tender) and pos/service.ts settlePayment. FIX: make these orchestrator-only; agents hand over patch notes.

Several definitions of one thing (standing duplicate rule). COD rows would be classified separately by /pos/cod-due, the new /reconciliation/cod, salesByTender and the codCustody worker. FIX: one lib/cod.ts exporting codDueWhere and codStatusOf, read by all four. Rider statuses only for fulfilmentType 'delivery' with a riderId. Pickup cash orders are on the same list today (see code_facts) and need their own status ('at_counter'), never a rider debt or a rider-overdue flag.

Legacy NULL-company bans against company separation. The plan leaves multi-company auto-bans with tenantId NULL ('applies everywhere'). An appeal needs 'a brand of the ban's company' and has none to use, and a lift from any company's naughty list or complaints queue lifts it for every company. FIX: in the migration, split each attributable multi-company auto-ban into one ban per company (copy the row with each tenantId, mark the original lifted with reason 'split per company'). A truly unattributable ban appeals at the company of the brand the customer was refused at, and only admin can lift it.
missing: A screen for staff to type the customer's code. POST /trustops/orders/:id/verify-otp has no frontend caller (only tests). Admin /dispatch, /riders and the tablet Dispatch offered only 'Delivered'. Once that button is removed, a rider without the app has no normal way to close a delivery, only the emergency reroute. Add an 'Enter customer's code' action where Delivered was (agents E and F), with attemptsLeft and the 423 lock state.

Ban appeals stored in OrderComplaint will show up in its current readers. Filter kind='complaint' in: the complaint follow-up worker (workers/loyaltyTriggers.ts:283-330, which would text a blocked customer 'did we make it right?' after the appeal is resolved); the customer rollup complaint count (lib/customerRollups.ts:50); the open-complaints KPIs (management/routes.ts:190, 237, 245); the complaint-cluster flag (opsReports/routes.ts:232); the CRM profile list (crm/routes.ts:449). Also: PATCH /complaints must refuse status 'resolved' on a ban_appeal (only lift or release-contact resolve it). The appeal sets category 'other' and a fixed title (both are required columns). banId gets a relation to CustomerBan with onDelete SetNull.
Food-returned needs pickedUpAt on app jobs. Without it, it works as a general waste-cancel before the bag ever leaves the kitchen (also useful for riderScoring).

COD delivered through the old manager override has deliveryOtpVerifiedAt NULL, so rider-debt refuses it (COD_NOT_DELIVERED_WITH_CODE) and it stays on cod-due for ever. Add a legacy path: finance books the rider debt with legacy:true and a reason, or it goes to the CEO-approved bad-debt seam (owner rule: the CEO approves every bad debt). Say which.

Tests the plan does not cover: tests/sepTrustops.test.ts:87-95 (GET /trustops/orders/:id/otp, owner agent A); tests/raastReports.test.ts:124 (cod.notCollected* shape, owner agent D); tests/riderApp.test.ts:765 (admin reads deliveryOtp); tests/accessControl.test.ts (verify-otp). Two-company tests for GET /reconciliation/cod, GET /storefront/account/blocks and the GET /emergency-overrides list with a fleet rider.

Text that still says a manager marks it delivered, to be rewritten: rider/service.ts:323 (NO_OTP 'Call the dispatcher to mark it delivered'); rider/service.ts:351 and trustops/routes.ts:216 (lost_package descriptions); orders/routes.ts:253 (COMPLETE_ON_DELIVERY 'use Dispatch'); the expo/routes.ts:688-690 comment; the schema.prisma comment on Order.deliveredAt; the '/dispatch' rule comment in moduleAccess.ts. Coordination with food cost. wasteVoidedFiredLineTx costs at the moving-average unitCostCents and credits only 1210. Reservations (/reserve/<slug>) and the group-order page also return BANNED. Agent G's file list should add the appeal notice there.

Inter-company (H30, default 'iou'). If the Wave B inter-company area builds due-to / due-from accounts, a fleet rider's COD debt is booked as Dr due-from-provider in the order's company, not as 1351 with a TODO.

refundOrder refuses non-completed orders: pos/service.ts:2795-2806 (assertRefundableStatus: 422 NOT_REFUNDABLE, 'cancel it instead'). Cancelled tickets hand money back through refundDueOnCancelledTicket (pos/service.ts:3436-3439). So PAID_USE_REFUND points to a path that refuses.
reverseJournalEntry posts sourceType '<orig>.reversal' (journal.ts:286-291). The reversal key is 'cod.rider_debt.reversal:<paymentId>', not 'cod.rider_debt:<paymentId>:reversal'.

'management' is the CEO/exec role (auth/middleware.ts:245). cancelOrder audits with tenantId: input.actor?.tenantId (orders/service.ts:1634), the operator's company.

withdrawOffer (takeRiderOff with onlyIfNotAccepted) is called in loops by workers/riderDispatch.ts:136, riders/routes.ts:174 and rider/service.ts:184.
complaints/routes.ts:32, 81 and 156 scope with req.staffUser.tenantFilter. /complaints has no GATED_PREFIXES rule (moduleAccess.ts:318-442).

Other readers of OrderComplaint: workers/loyaltyTriggers.ts:288 (follow-up after 'resolved'), lib/customerRollups.ts:50, management/routes.ts:190, 237 and 245, opsReports/routes.ts:232, crm/routes.ts:449.

CustomerBan.tenantId exists (migration 20260927190000 backfilled staff bans from bannedBy's primary company), but nothing writes it: neither crm/routes.ts:1205 nor strikes.ts:125. banCompanies (crm/customerScope.ts:144-170) never reads it. markDelivered is the only writer of deliveredAt (dispatch/service.ts:483). PATCH /orders/:id/status already refuses to complete a delivery (orders/routes.ts:250-254), so with the staffClose path and the /delivered route removed there is no code-free completion left.

Order depletion runs at ingest (fire-and-forget, the stock.sale_deplete audit row; orders/service.ts:70-131), so a 'ready' order that comes back normally has a depletion for wasteVoidedFiredLineTx to take from. restoreInventoryForOrder then gives back only `taken`, which the waste has reduced (voidWaste.ts:84-106).

The tablet gates tabs through NAV_MODULES (tablet/app/(staff)/_layout.tsx:50) and has a local MANAGER_ROLES at dispatch.tsx:84. The tablet nav uses emoji icons; that is allowed, since the no-emoji rule covers the storefront only.
corrected_plan_notes:
1. Food came back:
- Accept paid tenders. Cancel with waste in the hook, and leave any money to the existing cancelled-ticket hand-back (refundOrder -> refundDueOnCancelledTicket). Return refundDueCents in the response.
- Require pickedUpAt on app jobs.
- Audit in the order's company (fix cancelOrder's tenantId).
- Write the 'returned' job event with the rider's company resolved through serviceClient, outside the RLS transaction.
- Run requireManagerApproval for till ('pos') orders.

2. Roles:
- emergency_overrides by default goes to boh_management, fnb_manager and foh_management (the RGM). management and admin get it automatically.
- Explicitly filter it out of OWNER_MODULES and MANAGER_MODULES.
- Add MODULE_GRANTS and the '/emergency-overrides' GATED rule.

3. takeRiderOff: a rerouted, undelivered order is a no-op for system and offer-withdraw callers. Only an explicit dispatcher assign or unassign gets 409 CODE_WITH_RIDER.

4. Replace every 'Delivered' button (admin /dispatch, admin /riders, tablet) with 'Enter customer's code' (verify-otp). Show the Emergency overrides link only when the code has locked or the rider reported a door problem.

5. One lib/cod.ts (codDueWhere + codStatusOf), read by:
- /pos/cod-due;
- /reconciliation/cod;
- salesByTender;
- the codCustody worker.

Rider statuses apply only to delivery orders with a rider. Pickup cash orders get 'at_counter'. Add a legacy path for COD delivered by the old override (finance with legacy:true, or the CEO bad-debt seam).

6. Strikes and bans:
- Fix marketingAudience and the loyaltyTriggers referral check to per-company bans in this change.
- The migration splits legacy multi-company auto-bans into per-company rows. Unattributable ones can be lifted by admin only.
- Remove 'cod_unpaid' from the manual strike kinds.

7. Complaints:
- scopeTenantWhere on /stats.
- Add a GATED_PREFIXES rule for '/complaints'.
- Appeal details go to MANAGERS only.
- Filter kind='complaint' in loyaltyTriggers, customerRollups, management, opsReports and the CRM profile.
- PATCH refuses 'resolved' on an appeal.
- Appeals use category 'other'; banId gets a relation.
- conceptSlug is resolved on the server to the ban's company.

8. Release-contact must take the phone off the banned account so a recycled number gets a new account (pending Q7).

9. Fix the reversal key: 'cod.rider_debt.reversal:<paymentId>'.

10. Build split:
- Move these to the orchestrator: pos/routes.ts, pos/service.ts, voidWaste.ts, backfillOrders.ts, reports/service.ts, chartOfAccounts.ts, trustops/routes.ts, appRoles.ts.
- Add sepTrustops.test.ts and accessControl.test.ts to agent A, raastReports.test.ts to agent D.
- Add /reserve and group-order pages to agent G.

11. Coordinate voidWaste with the food-cost area (FIFO lots and 1210/1220/1230 incl. packaging) and with the inter-company area (H30 due-from) before the agents start. Reserve 1351 across Wave B.

12. Update all the 'a manager marks it delivered' text (listed under missing). Rewrite both CLAUDE.md Own-fleet bullets.

The user asked for TARGETED QUESTIONS instead of an artifact. Ask these with AskUserQuestion (defaults in brackets):
- Q1. RGM in servd is which login: floor manager (foh_management) or exec (management)? [foh_management also gets Emergency overrides]
- Q2. 'Send code to rider': send a new code (the customer's old code stops working) or the same code? [new code]
- Q3. Show the rerouted code in the rider app as well as WhatsApp, in case WhatsApp is down? [yes]
- Q4. Customer unreachable (not a refusal): strike or no strike? [no strike]
- Q5. Customer prepaid online and the food came back: refund them, keep the money, or the manager decides each time? [the manager decides through the existing hand-back]
- Q6. When a ban is lifted on appeal: also forgive that company's strikes, or keep them so the next strike re-blocks? [keep]
- Q7. Recycled number: take the number off the blocked account so the new owner starts a fresh account? [yes]
- Q8. Are riders on servd payroll? If yes, COD they owe goes to 1350 and is recovered from wages (H5 wording); if not, a new 1351 recovered at the till. [1351]
- Q9. Can a blocked customer still sign in, with a notice and an appeal, or should sign-in on that brand's own site be refused? [sign in allowed]
